statement.document_title: DALL-E’s New Guardrails: Fast, Furious, and Far from Airtight

our_interpretation: Whack-a-mole means repeatedly fixing discovered failures while related bypasses continue to emerge.
Generally describes a common pattern across builders, not merely one documented patch.
For this ongoing industry-practice claim, I use the latest completed quarter through the post date: October 2023 through January 10, 2024.
criteria.support_condition: Update histories and repeated evaluations across multiple leading builders establish recurring specific fixes followed by related bypasses as a common pattern.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Representative histories establish that broad, durable fixes were the usual pattern and repeated specific patching was exceptional.
